class_guess: Bell eats counter: W4-2's counter (BECv5 family) in a mirror, started in W4-2's F; F1 = 1RC is a 3-step detour of W4-2's F1 = 1LF
summary: W4-2 in a mirror, started in F, with F1 stretched into a 3-step detour; W4-2's rules and invariant cover it.
mechanism: 349 = W4-2's table with F1 = 1RC (W4-2: 1LF), mirrored and renamed (F->A, A->B, ..., E->F); its blank run is W4-2's table started in F.
Only A1 enters F, so F always has a 1 on its right: F1 C1 A1 (3 steps) does what W4-2's F1 does in 1 (in 349's letters: 1 A> 1 -> A1 D1 B1 -> 1 1 A>). Exact lockstep over 3e7 steps, 479 detours.
So the run is W4-2's run from F: K'('',0,1) at step 14, (std,2,2) at step 73, inside W4-2's invariant I; every rule, Lemma S and Lemma C carry over (Eqv_v3 TM518 pairs them too, but imports BBinf).

rules.name: init
rules.cases: = K'('',0,1) = (std,0,1), the mirror of W4-2's K('',0,1) reached from F; then S0 gives K'(001,0,2) = (std,2,2) at step 73, inside I

rules.name: detour (Lemma E)
rules.cases: 349's A1 = W4-2's F1 seen in the mirror; TM518 tm (= W4-2) does it in 1 step (A1 = 1RA). Only B1 enters A from the left side, so the cell left of A is always 1

rules.name: R1 bounce
rules.cases: n >= 1; phi = W4-2's phi with w read from the head rightwards; L'(w) = 1 if w starts with 0, else 2e+3+2*p11 ((e,e+1) = first 00 pair, p11 = 11 pairs before it = detours)

rules.name: R2 overflow, q even
rules.cases: phi(w) = 0^q 1 x, q even: K'(x, m+1+q/2, 0) (W4-2's R2 / BECv5's ROv)

rules.name: R4 overflow halt
rules.cases: phi(w) = 0^q 1 1 x, q odd; never met inside a macro rule (W4-2 Lemma S); R5 (0^q 1 01 x) nests, also never met

rules.name: macro S0
rules.cases: N+1 = (2k+1)2^i, b = m+1+i, L = bitlen(k), r = k-2^(L-1); k = 0 (W4-2 proof.md 3.4, unchanged); runs to the first clean overflow with N' >= 1

rules.name: macro S1
rules.cases: N+1 = (2k+1)2^i, b = m+1+i, L = bitlen(k), r = k-2^(L-1); k >= 1, k = 2^(L-1) or 2k+b >= 2^(L+1) (W4-2 proof.md 3.4, unchanged); runs to the first clean overflow with N' >= 1

rules.name: macro S2
rules.cases: N+1 = (2k+1)2^i, b = m+1+i, L = bitlen(k), r = k-2^(L-1); k not a power of 2, 2k+b+1 = 2^(L+1) (W4-2 proof.md 3.4, unchanged); runs to the first clean overflow with N' >= 1

rules.name: macro S3a
rules.cases: N+1 = (2k+1)2^i, b = m+1+i, L = bitlen(k), r = k-2^(L-1); final gap, g = 0 (W4-2 proof.md 3.4, unchanged); runs to the first clean overflow with N' >= 1

rules.name: macro S3b
rules.cases: N+1 = (2k+1)2^i, b = m+1+i, L = bitlen(k), r = k-2^(L-1); final gap, g >= 1, n >= 2^(h+1)-2g (W4-2 proof.md 3.4, unchanged); runs to the first clean overflow with N' >= 1

rules.name: macro P0
